# Web: Settings → Connections for GitHub and GitLab

## What to build

Add a **Connections** section to the web settings overlay. Desktop gets it too, because Electron hosts the web UI. In this section a user can:

- connect GitHub with a token;
- connect GitLab with a token, or with their own OAuth app;
- see their connections and disconnect them.

The section calls the existing oRPC procedures and adds a web callback page that finishes GitLab OAuth.

Keep the UI and copy minimal, per AGENTS.md:
- Each connected account is one row: provider name plus account label, with a Disconnect button.
- An "add" row opens a small dialog with Server URL and Token fields.
- GitLab's OAuth fields stay hidden until the user switches to OAuth.

No explainer text. Each new visible string must be quoted and justified in the PR description. The planned copy, with reasons:

| Copy | Why it's needed |
|---|---|
| "Connections" | nav label |
| "GitHub", "GitLab" | provider names |
| "Server URL", "Token", "Client ID", "Client secret" | field labels |
| "Use OAuth app" | toggle, GitLab only |
| "Connect", "Disconnect" | actions |

Error messages come from the server, or use these short fixed strings:
- "Missing scopes: …"
- "Token has scopes it should not: …"

Already in the codebase:
- **Connections** (`packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts` `codeHosts` block):
  - `codeHosts.connections.list` returns `CodeHostConnection[]`, where each entry is `{ id, provider: "github"|"gitlab", baseUrl, authKind: "token"|"oauth", label, createdAt }`.
  - `codeHosts.connections.remove({ connectionId })` returns `{ ok: true }`.
- **Token connect**: `codeHosts.github.connectToken({ baseUrl, token })` and `codeHosts.gitlab.connectToken({ baseUrl, token })` return a `CodeHostConnection`. Scope errors carry `data: { error: "missing_scopes", missing: string[] }` or `data: { error: "excess_scopes", excess: string[] }`.
- **GitLab OAuth**:
  - `codeHosts.gitlab.oauth.start({ baseUrl, clientId, clientSecret, client: "web" })` returns `{ authorizeUrl }`.
  - The API redirects GitLab's callback to `<webOrigin>/code-hosts/gitlab/callback?code=…&state=…`.
  - `codeHosts.gitlab.oauth.complete({ state, code })` returns a `CodeHostConnection`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/web/src/pages/shell-overlay.ts` (lines 1–15): `SETTINGS_SECTIONS`. Add `"connections"`.
- `apps/web/src/pages/settings-nav.ts`: `useSettingsNavItems()` builds items such as `{ id: "vault", label: t\`Vault\`, icon: KeyRound }`. Add `{ id: "connections", label: t\`Connections\`, icon: GitBranch }`, using the lucide `GitBranch` icon, placed after "vault" and before "messaging".
- `apps/web/src/pages/SettingsOverlay.tsx`:
  - lines 231 and 266: `data-testid="user-settings"`, `settings-nav-${id}`;
  - lines 388–421: section panels.
- `apps/web/src/pages/MessagingSettingsPanel.tsx`: the closest pattern to mirror.
  - lines 58–95: `useSpaceQueries()`, `queries.messaging.installations.list.queryOptions()`, `useQuery`, `fetchFresh(queryClient, options)` after changes;
  - lines 219–231: open a popup first, then set its URL;
  - lines 318–380: list with `SettingsGroup`/`SettingsRow` and Disconnect.
- `apps/web/src/components/SettingsRows.tsx`: `SettingsGroup`, `SettingsRow`.
- `apps/web/src/pages/SlackInstallCallback.tsx`: callback page that calls `complete` and then `navigate("/app?settings=messaging")`. Mirror it for GitLab.
- `apps/web/src/App.tsx`:
  - lines 105–122: callback path constants, and the `signInDestination` allow-list for callbacks that arrive signed out;
  - lines 218–230: route with `Navigate` to sign-in when there is no user.
- `packages/ui-web/src/components/ui/`: `dialog.tsx`, `field.tsx`, `input.tsx`, `switch.tsx`, `button.tsx`. Reuse these. Don't hand-write chrome or hardcode colors; use semantic tokens.
- `apps/web/src/lib/rpc.ts` (`rpc`) and `apps/web/src/lib/query.ts` (`useSpaceQueries`, `useSpaceRpc`).
- `apps/web/e2e/helpers.ts`:
  - line 26 `rpc`, line 66 `signup`, line 35 `completeOnboarding`, line 162 `captureScreenshot`;
  - line 202 `openUserSettings`: extend its section union with `"connections"`.
- `apps/web/e2e/messaging-settings.spec.ts`: an e2e spec that stubs RPCs with `page.route("**/rpc/…", r => r.fulfill({ contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify({ json: … }) }))`. Mirror it.

## Patterns to follow

**Query + mutation:**
```tsx
const queries = useSpaceQueries();
const rpc = useSpaceRpc();
const listOptions = queries.codeHosts.connections.list.queryOptions();
const list = useQuery(listOptions);
async function disconnect(id: string) { await rpc.codeHosts.connections.remove({ connectionId: id }); await fetchFresh(queryClient, listOptions); }
```
**Popup for OAuth.** Open `about:blank` synchronously in the click handler, then set `location.href` after `start` resolves. Fall back to `window.location.assign(url)` when the popup is blocked. This is the same as `installSlack` in `MessagingSettingsPanel.tsx`.

**Strings.** Use the Lingui `t` macro or `<Trans>` like the surrounding files. Then run the repo's i18n extract step, if there is one. Check `apps/web/package.json` for `lingui extract` and the CI check for missing catalogs.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/web/src/pages/CodeHostSettingsPanel.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT** the panel:
  - A `SettingsGroup` with one `SettingsRow` per connection:
    - label: "GitHub" or "GitLab";
    - muted meta: `label`, plus the hostname when it isn't github.com/gitlab.com;
    - a Disconnect button;
    - `data-testid="code-host-connection-<id>"`.
  - Two add rows: "GitHub" and "GitLab", each with a `PlusIcon`.
  - Each add row opens a `Dialog` (`data-testid="code-host-connect-dialog"`) with:
    - "Server URL": an `Input` prefilled with `https://github.com` or `https://gitlab.com`;
    - "Token": an `Input type="password" autoComplete="off"`;
    - GitLab only: a "Use OAuth app" `Switch`. When on, it swaps the Token field for "Client ID" and "Client secret" inputs.
    - a "Connect" button.
  - Behavior:
    - Connect calls the matching procedure, closes the dialog and refreshes the list.
    - Errors render inline below the fields. Map `missing_scopes` and `excess_scopes` from the error's `data`; otherwise show the server's message.
    - In OAuth mode, Connect calls `oauth.start` and opens the URL in a popup or the same tab.
  - Clear the token and secret fields from React state on close and on success.
- **GOTCHA**: never put tokens in URLs, query keys, `console` or analytics. If the app has a setting-analytics hook (`bot-setting-analytics.ts` exists server side), send no token values.

### CREATE `apps/web/src/pages/GitlabOauthCallback.tsx` + route
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  1. Read `state` and `code` from the URL.
  2. Call `rpc.codeHosts.gitlab.oauth.complete({ state, code })`.
  3. Then `navigate("/app?settings=connections")`.
  4. On error, show the same minimal failure UI that `SlackInstallCallback.tsx` uses.
- In `App.tsx`:
  - add `const GITLAB_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PATH = "/code-hosts/gitlab/callback";`;
  - add it to the `signInDestination` allow-list;
  - add a `<Route>` that requires a user, with the same `Navigate` pattern.

### UPDATE settings wiring
- Add `"connections"` to `SETTINGS_SECTIONS`, add the nav item in `settings-nav.ts`, and add `{section === "connections" ? <CodeHostSettingsPanel /> : null}` in `SettingsOverlay.tsx`.
- **GOTCHA**: check every exhaustive `switch`/record over `SettingsSection`, and fix any type errors from `pnpm --filter @rakazo/web check`.

### Tests
- **Unit tests**, if `apps/web` has component tests next to similar panels (search for `MessagingSettingsPanel.test.tsx`). Mirror them for:
  - the list rendering;
  - the token dialog submitting the right input;
  - scope error rendering.
- **E2E** `apps/web/e2e/code-host-settings.spec.ts`. Stub:
  - `**/rpc/codeHosts/connections/list`;
  - `**/rpc/codeHosts/gitlab/connectToken` (success, and a `missing_scopes` failure);
  - `**/rpc/codeHosts/gitlab/oauth/start`, returning a local `/gitlab-test-authorize` URL.

  Steps:
  1. `signup` + `completeOnboarding`.
  2. `openUserSettings(page, "connections")`.
  3. Expect the "GitHub" and "GitLab" rows.
  4. Open GitLab, enter a token, Connect. The stubbed list now returns the connection, and its row appears.
  5. Failure case: expect "Missing scopes: write_repository".
  6. OAuth toggle: `page.waitForEvent("popup")`.
  7. `captureScreenshot(page, testInfo, "code-host-connections")`.
- Extend the `openUserSettings` union in `apps/web/e2e/helpers.ts`.
- Per AGENTS.md, do not run the desktop Playwright suite locally. Run only the web e2e spec, through the harness.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Settings shows a "Connections" nav item (`data-testid="settings-nav-connections"`) and a panel listing the user's GitHub/GitLab connections.
- [ ] GitHub and GitLab token connect work from the dialog, with inline scope errors.
- [ ] GitLab OAuth opens the authorize URL, and `/code-hosts/gitlab/callback` completes it and returns to `?settings=connections`, including after a signed-out sign-in redirect.
- [ ] Disconnect removes the row.
- [ ] Tokens and secrets never leave the form except in the RPC body.
- [ ] Only the planned copy is added. The UI uses existing `@rakazo/ui-web` components and semantic tokens.
- [ ] Tests pass: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/web check` and `pnpm test:e2e --spec=code-host-settings`.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm lint && pnpm check
pnpm --filter @rakazo/web test
pnpm test:e2e --spec=code-host-settings
```
